description: How to deposit, exactly like app.felix.trade: money settles as USDC in the account's Arc home Safe (re-derived locally from the account's own owner key). With no arguments: the Arc home, whether a new account's home is funded enough to finish create_account, and the deposit steps. list_currencies:true lists accepted tokens; from_currency + from_amount previews what a deposit delivers; request_id tracks a deposit from create_deposit. Read-only: creates nothing.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID (for example the one create_account returned). Omit for the active account.

from_amount.description: Amount of from_currency for a preview.

from_currency.description: Deposit token key for a preview, for example usdc_base, usdc_arbitrum, eth, btc, sol.

list_currencies.description: List the accepted deposit tokens and their keys.

request_id.description: request_id from create_deposit, to track that deposit.

name: get_deposit_address
